idea-plugin.name: FB Inspect - Image Viewer for Native Debugging
idea-plugin.description:
A plugin for Android Studio that provides the ability to visualize byte arrays as images during native C++ debugging with LLDB.
Features: - View byte arrays as images in the debugger - Configurable width, height, and channels - Support for common image formats (RGB, RGBA, Grayscale)

action.description: Display variable as image with specified dimensions
